meta.title: JARVIS — Homelab AI Cluster
meta.description: JARVIS — a private 18-node Kubernetes homelab: declarative GitOps infrastructure, multi-tier local AI inference, vision tracking, and zero-trust network segmentation.

hero.description: An 18-node Kubernetes homelab that thinks, sees, and listens at home — run entirely declaratively, with multi-tier local AI inference and zero-trust network segmentation.

goLive.title: Go-Live Countdown
goLive.description: Planned production start of the entire cluster — from bare-metal bootstrap to the speaking assistant.

systemMap.title: The Entire Toolchain at a Glance
systemMap.description: JARVIS as the hub across six domains — from GitOps and AI inference to security, voice & vision, and observability.

features.title: What JARVIS Does
features.description: From bare-metal node to speaking assistant — every capability runs on its own network, declaratively managed and versioned.

items.title: GitOps Infrastructure
items.description: A Git monorepo as the single source of truth. Ansible for the node layer, FluxCD for cluster state — every change is a reviewable commit, every drift is reconciled automatically.

items.title: 18-Node Bare-Metal Cluster
items.description: Raspberry Pi 5s, an ODROID-H5, and a GPU workstation combined into a K3s cluster — from edge device to inference hardware, all self-hosted, no cloud VMs.

items.title: Multi-Tier Local AI Inference
items.description: Requests are routed across staged hardware tiers — from NPU edge devices for instant short answers to a GPU workstation for complex reasoning. Cloud serves only as a tightly limited fallback.

items.title: Vision Tracker
items.description: Active person recognition with camera tracking (pan/tilt/zoom). Processing stays entirely in-cluster; only embeddings of enrolled people are stored — never raw images, no cloud path.

items.title: Voice Assistant & HUD
items.description: Wake-word detection, speech output, and a heads-up display showing identity and status in real time — including personalized greetings and presence-triggered automations.

items.title: Zero-Trust Network Segmentation
items.description: Default-deny network policies per workload namespace, encrypted node-to-node traffic, and an explicit, versioned allow-set instead of implicit reachability.

items.title: Security & Compliance
items.description: Controls aligned with ISO 27001, NIS-2, and CIS: secrets stored encrypted only, full API audit logging, runtime threat detection, and automated image scanning.

items.title: Automated Version Governance
items.description: Dependencies and chart versions are continuously checked and proposed as reviewable pull requests — no silent 'latest', every change visible and traceable.

items.title: Backup, DR & Observability
items.description: Tested backup and restore paths for the entire cluster, continuous monitoring, and dashboards across nodes, workloads, and network.

items.title: Home Automation
items.description: Integration with smart-home devices on the local network and presence-driven automations, orchestrated from the same platform as the AI and voice services.

pipeline.title: Fully Declarative Rollout
pipeline.description: No more imperative Bash: every layer of the cluster is managed by a dedicated tool, every change is a commit.

steps.title: Ansible
steps.description: Node layer: OS, storage, GPU, and device preparation.

steps.title: Helmfile
steps.description: Minimal pre-Flux bootstrap for the core cluster services.

steps.title: FluxCD
steps.description: Rolls out all cluster workloads declaratively and reconciles drift automatically.

steps.title: Renovate
steps.description: Automatically opens pull requests for every version update.

pipeline.footerNote: git commit → git push → Flux reconciles cluster state back to the Git source automatically

modelTiers.title: The Right Hardware for Every Request
modelTiers.description: Requests are routed across staged tiers — from edge accelerator to GPU workstation. Cloud is a tightly bounded fallback, not the default path.

rows.role: Last resort only, the single permitted egress

security.title: Aligned with ISO 27001, NIS-2, and CIS
security.description: Even as a private project, run like a production system — with documented controls instead of trust by word of mouth.
highlights: Encryption of sensitive cluster data at rest
Full API audit logging with RBAC traceability
Secrets stored encrypted only in the repository (never in plaintext)
Policy enforcement, runtime threat detection, and image scanning
security.footerNote: Infrastructure details, internal network addresses, and operational scripts stay private and are deliberately not published on this site.
